title: Fit the work-queue verbs into the preamble command-surface budget

must_haves.why: The five work-queue verbs scur-2 declared grow the preamble command surface to 2947 characters, over its 2900 budget, and the full suite is red.

action: Change COMMAND_SURFACE_BUDGET_CHARS in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs from 2900 to 3000, per decision 26ead1c7. Change nothing else. If another session_preamble budget test also fails for the same growth, report it instead of widening scope. No code comments. Proof: the cell verify; quote the counts.
